description: Edits the settings of ONE outreach campaign the user owns, by campaignId. Only the fields passed change; the others keep their value. Fields: campaign name, offering (what the user's company sells), give (something useful offered before asking for the reader's time, such as a diagnosis, a sample or a draft), sender name, company, role and URL, tone, goal, call to action, message length, constraints (what the messages must never say), business context, and which connected Gmail mailbox, LinkedIn or WhatsApp account sends. It sends no message, adds or removes no people, does not start, pause or resume the campaign, and does not edit the cadence's messages. "O que a campanha oferece" (the activation item) and "O que você dá antes de pedir" are the give, not the offering. A new give on a campaign that already has a cadence writes the cadence's template again from it right away; the people's messages are not rewritten by this call: the result's messagesOutdated counts them and messagesNext describes the rewrite still pending.

businessContext.description: Company and product context the campaign's messages respect. Leave it out to keep it.

constraints.description: Things the copy must never say or do. Leave it out to keep it.

cta.description: Desired next step: reply, book_call, accept_connect, share_resource, or custom text.

give.description: "O que a campanha oferece": concrete value handed over before asking for the reader's time (a diagnosis, a sample, a draft). Leave it out to keep it.

goal.description: Campaign objective: conversion, awareness, consultative, meeting, relationship, or custom text.

linkedinAccountId.description: Connected LinkedIn accountId. Leave it out to keep it.

mailboxId.description: Connected Gmail mailbox UUID. Leave it out to keep it.

offering.description: What the company sells / the offer used in generated messages.

rewriteMessages.description: A new give writes the cadence's template again by default; false only when the user asked to keep the messages as they are.

senderCompany.description: Sender company name. Leave it out to keep it.

senderCompanyUrl.description: Sender company URL. Leave it out to keep it.

senderLinkChannels.description: Channels that may include the sender link: email, linkedin, whatsapp.

senderName.description: Name used in message signatures. Leave it out to keep it.

senderRole.description: Sender role. Leave it out to keep it.

signalGate.description: How to use company buying signals: personalize messages, or skip people missing the chosen signal.

tone.description: Message tone, e.g. consultative, professional, friendly, direct.

whatsappAccountId.description: Connected WhatsApp accountId. Leave it out to keep it.
